title: e0 encoded sources export — bit depth, range, matrix, mp4 pipeline

commit.merge_subject: merge: e0 encoded sources export — bit depth, range, matrix, mp4 pipeline

description:
Mi-Log and MP4 clips could be edited but never exported: the queue gave
them to the MCRAW decoder. Add EncodedMp4Session, an Mp4Session over the
same EncodedSource the preview uses (MediaExtractor + MediaCodec, P010,
developEncoded, one EncodedColorSpec), so ExportPlan, ExportSettings,
MediaCodecMp4Writer, staging, progress and the report are reused
unchanged.

- frames leave as unrotated RGB888; the pipeline rotates/crops/scales
  exactly as for MCRAW (container orientation reported in the info).
- audio: the clip's AAC track decoded by MediaExtractorAudioSource on its
  own dup of the fd, handed to the writer as PCM (absent track = video
  only). The audio link state (detached/removed) still applies.
- Mp4Exporter.isEncoded (wired in AppNav from the source kind): encoded
  jobs use the encoded session, CPU develop and no gyro warp. A 10-bit
  request is re-planned to 8-bit by the E1d p
changed: fix: read encoded bit depth, range and matrix
feat: export encoded clips through the e1 pipeline
